item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will continue to bring fine and dry weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over the region and the weather will be generally cold tomorrow morning. Replenishments of the monsoon will persist over southern China early to midweek next week. It will remain cool in the morning and at night over the coastal areas. Besides, the area of low pressure now near the southern part of the Philippines is expected to move across the southern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week. The associated band of clouds will cover the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong.
